content:
Thunderbird looks up contacts from your default android contacts app such as google contacts.

1. Grant the app permission to read your contacts data. 2. Add a contact name and email address to your contacts app. 3. Open the compose screen in Thunderbird for android. 4. Tap the three dot menu > add from contacts.

Note: The "Add from contacts" option is not visible until permissions have been granted. See screen shots.
